en: Designing and building robust backend services and microservices with Java and Spring Boot.
Contributing to agile development within a scaled LeSS (Large-Scale Scrum) framework.

en: Continuously contributed to development projects, including between theory phases.
Extended the backend unit-test suite for MagentaTV to improve maintainability.
Evaluated and introduced Playwright as an end-to-end testing framework, including tool selection and best practices, and implemented automated E2E tests for a web portal.
Worked agile using Scrum (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization).
